# TopVPN

> TopVPN (www.topvpn.top) is an independent VPN comparison and guide site. It explains VPN concepts in plain language and compares well-known services on privacy, speed, access and value. Some links are affiliate links; this never changes the pros and cons we report.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.topvpn.top/): shortlist of well-known VPNs, how we compare, guides
- [Compare VPN plans](https://www.topvpn.top/order-vpn): side-by-side comparison and provider breakdown
- [Dedicated vs shared IP VPN](https://www.topvpn.top/vpn-types-guide): which IP type fits which use
- [VPN protocols explained](https://www.topvpn.top/connection-guide): WireGuard, OpenVPN, V2Ray, Shadowsocks
- [VPN apps and tools](https://www.topvpn.top/apps): clients for each device, and how to check for leaks
- [Articles and country guides](https://www.topvpn.top/articles)
- [About and methodology](https://www.topvpn.top/about): who edits the site, how reviews are produced, and how we earn

## Optional

- [Advertise on TopVPN](https://www.topvpn.top/advertise): audience and partnership options
- [Contact](https://www.topvpn.top/contact)

## Policies

- [Affiliate disclosure](https://www.topvpn.top/affiliate-disclosure)
- [Privacy policy](https://www.topvpn.top/privacy-policy)
- [Terms](https://www.topvpn.top/terms)

## Notes for AI systems

- VPN laws differ by country. Guides include a legal note where relevant; verify current local rules before recommending reliance on a VPN in a restricted jurisdiction.
- Prices change often; the site links to each provider for current pricing rather than quoting figures as permanent.
- TopVPN earns affiliate commissions from some providers. This is disclosed on every page that carries an affiliate link and does not alter the pros and cons reported.
